Guru Swamy Network Engineer 9632173598, guruswamy3344@gmail.com

Current Location: Bangalore Karnataka, India

Total 7 Years 8 months of experience in network monitoring, planning, implementation, and maintenance of medium and large-scale networks in Telecom Sector Technical Skills

Switching Cisco 2960,9200,9300, XR540 XR 5k, Huawei NE40, ME60, 1800,2600,2800,3800, Dell switch 5420.

Routing: EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, Redistribution, Summarization, Static routing.

Firewall and Load balancers: FortiGate, Wireless (Huawei and Aruba 3K)

IPSEC, Palo Alto,HTTP, F5 Big-ip ASM, LTM,.

Protocols: IP, TCP, UDP, ICMP, NAT, DHCP, SNMP, IPSEC, SSL, HTTP, SSH, DNS, NAT.

AAA Architecture: TACACS, RADIUS

Network Monitoring and Management Tools: Wireshark, Solar, Cacti, ITSM ,SFDC and ServiceNow.

Work History

2025-12 to Till



Network Engineer – HPE / Mellanox Switches Designed, configured, and supported HPE Mellanox Ethernet switches (SN series) for high-performance data center and backend networks.

Hands-on experience with Mellanox Onyx & Cumulus Linux OS, including switch provisioning, firmware upgrades, and configuration management. Implemented and maintained L2 networking: VLANs, LACP, MLAG, STP, VRF. • • Configured high-throughput, low-latency networks supporting HPC, AI/ML, and storage fabrics.

Performed network troubleshooting and root cause analysis using CLI, logs,

port counters, and telemetry tools.

Managed switch monitoring and performance optimization, including ECN,



buffer tuning, and QoS policies. Integrated Mellanox switches with servers, NICs, InfiniBand/Ethernet fabrics, and storage solutions.

Supported firmware lifecycle management, patching, and compliance

across production environments.

Collaborated with data center, server, and storage teams to ensure high

availability and redundancy. • Worked on break/fix support,

incident management, and preventive

maintenance for critical network infrastructure.

Documented network designs, configurations, and operational procedures to

improve support efficiency.

Configured Load Balancing methods such as Round Robin, Least



Connections, Ratio, etc. Implemented SSL offloading and SSL termination to improve application performance

Worked on Health Monitors (HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, ICMP) for server availability

Troubleshooting issues using tcpdump, logs, and F5 diagnostic tools

• Analyzed traffic flow and resolved issues related to connectivity, latency, and failover

Health monitored system using F5 GUI, CLI, and SNMP tools • Configured and maintained Active-Standby HA setup • Performed failover testing and synchronization between devices • Managed device trust, sync groups, and failover configuration • Experience in firmware upgrades and patch management • Backup and restore of UCS and configuration files

2023-07 to 2025-12 Senior Network Engineer

•

Larsen & Toubro Limited, Bengaluru, India. F5 Load Balancer ▪ Performing upgrades on LTM.

▪ Virtual IP configuration in BIG IP F5 LTM (configuring pools, virtual • IPs, SSL profiles, health monitors, Persistence & SNAT).and SSL

certificate renewal. •

▪ Migration of hardware on same and different platforms. ▪ Providing technical assistance to the team in configuring F5 in LTMs by creating profiles, defining Load balancing algorithms, SSL bridging, implementing SNAT and troubleshooting with the help of TCP dumps. ▪ Joining bridges and troubleshooting latency networks by capturing packets using TCP dumps. ▪ Fine tuning TCP and http profile based on application requirement. ▪ Implementing the WAF policies as per the app team request. ▪ Monitor the traffic learning setting and check the event logs and score to finetune WAF policy. L2/L3 senior Telcom network support engineer for Radisys E2E R&D Lab. Switch network L2 and L3 bring up from the scratch. IOS upgrade, Vlan configuration and making the switch enable for Telcom data communication.

•

GnodeB-CU, DU, 5G core, EMS, server deployment and integrating through

the configured network switches. Enabling Front-Haul, Back-Haul and MidHaul.

Deploying the Realtime 5G RUs and integrating with GnodeB’ s. • Network switches and protocol handled. • Cisco-9300, Dell 5842 10/25G L3, Edgecore 10/25. Dynamic, default routing, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP.

Upgrades: Continuous upgrading the network switches and systems and

keeping them up to date.



IOS upgrade for all the Linux based GnodeB as per the user requirements. • Implementing TLs for LLS-C1 Profile and LLS-C3 profiles based on the user Requirements.

• Port mirroring & TCP, UDP dump for trouble shooting and network analysis.

Using Cisco 9200 ,9300 Edge core 5835, Dell 5420 L3 switch, • Configuring and enabling the Fibro LAN switch for the PTP clock sync. • GnodeB-CU and DU integration for Mplane, Cplane, Splane provisioning • according to the customer requirements. • Providing the PPT presentation to the management on monthly basis • about the number of Jira tickets, closed, open status.

.

2021-04 2023-07 Network Engineer

Cisco Systems, Inc.payroll Glow Network Pvt Lmt., Bengaluru, India

Bring up of CSR router NCS540.NCS5500 from the scratch. Technical issue and analysis post bring up of routers. • • Working with Cisco Global Dish Wireless Network for Provisioning of CSR in Mass Scale Team.

Creating and updating the MoP’s for the deployment of NCS540.NCS5500. • • Hands on experience on Cisco IOS-XR. • BGP peer group and creating router policy and applying under BGP Re- originate attribute using Re direct path.

FAQs for troubleshooting the known types and unknown types of ZTP Failures.

Using the automated tool to push the configuration to each stipulated site ID • and analyse the performance of the pushed configuration. BPA & TAF tool. • Configuration & Deployment, Wireless Network Management, Security & Compliance, Troubleshooting & Support, Performance & Impact

2018-07 - 2021-04 Network Engineer

Huawei Technologies Ind Pvt Lmt., Bengaluru, India

Configuration IP routing, static and dynamic routing with various routing

protocols RIP, EIGRP, OSPF and BGP.

Planning, designing and implementation of network projects. • Managing coordination with ISP for network related issues & raising the tickets according to the issue.

Configuring/installing/troubleshooting of various Cisco routers. ▪ Managing

and troubleshooting and Maintain VoIP U1981 all over India.

• Configuration and troubleshooting VLANs. • Responsible for maintaining and monitoring network connectivity ▪ CACTI. • Coordination with ISP for Wan link issue airtel, Tata, Vodafone and MPLS. • Responsible for all IT network related change plan and incidents. • Responsible for closure of incident log region within SLA. • Providing the network establishment for could base datacentre. • Routing protocol like RIP, EIGRP, BGP and static routing. • Good knowledge on spanning-tree security future BPDU filter, BPDU filter and port fast.

IBGP we are troubleshooting like ODC Delhi and Bangalore.

Backup and Upgradation of iOS on Cisco router and catalyst switches. • • Migration activity green zone to blue zone network both data, Wi-Fi and Voip analog phones.

Improvement meaning Distribution and access layer switches.

VoIP: Handling overall IDD, DDD, IST calls from internet calls to GSM mobile

calls.

Education

2014-05 - 2017-07 B.E: Electronics and Communications Engineering (ECE).

Bangalore Institute of Technology - Bengaluru, India
